summary.text: Kirsten McTernan is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 82, in the November 3, 2026 general election. In a Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a wife, mother of four sons, educator, author and community leader.

paragraphs.text: Kirsten McTernan's survey response says she grew up overseas in England and Singapore and worked in public relations.
It says she has spent more than fourteen years in the district.
McTernan listed lowering costs, including by expanding natural gas production, as a key message.
She also named education priorities, including parental rights and expanded educational choice, and support for small businesses.
